title: Open Mic @ Western Cider
event_description: Weekly open mic welcoming singers poets and musicians of all genres. Hosted by Michael Enos with performances starting at 6:00 PM every Monday evening. All creative artists are welcome to share their talents in this supportive community atmosphere.
event_venue_information:
Western Cider: A Cidery & Community Hub

Western Cider is located on the banks of the Clark Fork River in Missoula Montana. This cidery and tasting room creates quality hard ciders from their own cider apple trees planted in Montana's Bitterroot Valley.

Regular Music Events

Western Cider hosts a variety of weekly music events including Monday Night Open Mic with Michael Enos and Old Time Jam sessions on the 1st and 3rd Wednesday of each month hosted by Lake Missoula Old Time. The venue welcomes musicians of all levels from beginners to seasoned players.

Venue Atmosphere

The spacious tasting room features indoor seating and a beautiful outdoor space along the river. With a focus on community the venue offers trivia nights yoga classes and other events alongside their craft cider selection. All ages are welcome making it a family-friendly gathering space.

title: Open Mic @ Imagine Nation Brewing
event_description: All-ages open mic night featuring music poetry comedy and spoken word. A welcoming space for performers and audience members to share creative talents. Sign-ups begin at 5:30 PM with performances from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM.
event_venue_information:
Imagine Nation Brewing: Community & Craft Beer

Imagine Nation Brewing is the first brewery in the country to include a center for community transformation. Through craft beer and education INBC creates a unique model of celebration and dialogue.

Mission & Values

Founded with the purpose to connect community through great beer and good conversation Imagine Nation emphasizes social change and transformation. The brewery hosts workshops dialogues and events that address challenges of our time.

Music & Events

The brewery features regular open mic nights live music performances and community gatherings. Their new taproom and event center near the Missoula airport includes over 3000 square feet with a beautiful outdoor beer garden and stage.

Craft Beer Selection

Award-winning brewery offering innovative small-batch beers including hoppy IPAs barrel-aged stouts pilsners and seasonal varieties. They source the finest hops and ingredients while supporting local suppliers and sustainable practices.

title: Open Mic @ Flipper's Casino & Tavern
event_description: Weekly open mic featuring musicians of all genres and experience levels. Sign-up begins at 6:00 PM with performances starting at 6:30 PM. A casual neighborhood venue with friendly atmosphere and great local beer selection.
venue_address: 125 S Third St W Missoula MT 59801
event_venue_information:
Flipper's Casino & Tavern: Local Favorite

Known as home to Missoula's best burgers Flipper's has been a neighborhood institution for years. This casual tavern and casino features 13 beers on tap with emphasis on local Montana craft breweries.

Music & Entertainment

Flipper's hosts weekly Tuesday night open mic sessions welcoming musicians of all levels. The venue also features occasional live bands and jazz performances in their comfortable indoor space.

Food & Atmosphere

The menu features fantastic burgers including the famous Chrondo burger bacon cheeseburgers and vegetarian options. Friendly service ample seating and a welcoming community vibe make this a beloved local gathering spot. The venue is located just off the bike path making it accessible for cyclists.

Gaming & Sports

Features a full casino with 19 gaming machines Golden Tee Golf and Big Buck Hunter. Multiple TV screens show sporting events creating a lively sports bar atmosphere perfect for watching games with friends.

title: Bluegrass Jam @ The Old Post
event_description: Weekly bluegrass jam session welcoming pickers and grinners of all skill levels. The Monday night shindig gets rolling around 5:30 PM with local musicians gathering to play traditional bluegrass standards and favorites.
event_venue_information:
The Old Post Pub: Downtown Missoula Institution

Located in the heart of downtown Missoula The Old Post has been a favorite destination for fantastic food and refreshing cocktails. The pub reopened in 2020 under new ownership by the Durham family committed to keeping this traditional establishment alive.

Live Music Schedule

The Old Post features an impressive weekly music lineup including Monday Night Bluegrass Jam Thursday Night Jazz with Chuck Florence David Horgan and Beth Lo and various live performances throughout the week. The venue has a small stage perfect for intimate performances.

Food & Drink

The menu features scratch-made meals including the famous drunken goat salad with fried goat cheese balls buttermilk honey fried chicken sandwich exceptional burgers crab cakes and chicken jambalaya. Full bar with craft cocktails and Montana brewed craft beers.

Atmosphere

Featuring Montana-themed decor including original Levi Strauss advertisements and vintage signage the pub offers a warm inviting atmosphere. Open daily from 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM serving breakfast lunch and dinner with weekend brunch.

title: Open Mic @ The Trough
event_description: June Tuesday night open mic series starting with Susan Morgan from Anything But Suzy then opening to solo or duo performers. All musical acts welcome that maintain a relaxed atmosphere. Susan can accompany performers on guitar if needed.
backline: Guitar accompaniment available PA system provided
event_venue_information:
The Trough: Neighborhood Market & Restaurant

The Trough opened in 2015 as part of The Olde Dairy complex bringing a community-oriented restaurant and market to the Target Range neighborhood. This converted historic dairy building features beautiful modern renovations.

Dining & Atmosphere

Offering breakfast brunch lunch and dinner The Trough serves quality scratch-made food in a cozy rustic atmosphere. The menu includes pulled pork mac and cheese salmon sandwiches steak fries and weekend brunch specialties. Indoor seating with fireplace and beautiful outdoor patio available.

Live Music & Events

The venue hosts regular live music performances including open mic nights trivia Tuesdays and performances by local musicians. The space can accommodate private events and parties up to 60 people.

Market & Convenience

Adjacent market features local products wine and microbrew selections Le Petite breads Montana Coffee Traders coffee ice cream and organic grocery options. The complex includes a functioning gas station making it a true neighborhood hub.
